_comment: Guardrail fragment injected into the active Kiro agent by apply-guardrails.py.
Kept separate because the AIM agent it merges into is regenerated on every
`aim agents update` — its resources/mcpServers embed a versioned eventId path,
so forking that agent would rot. Re-run the injector after an AIM update.
deniedCommands blocks without prompting (deny beats allow); the hook supplies
the reason. Rust regex: no lookahead, hence --force([^-].*|$) to spare

preToolUse.description: Deny with a reason instead of prompting; splits chained commands
